name: @trya11y/extension
description: TryA11y Chrome Extension — accessibility scanner with auto-fix and GitHub PR creation

scripts.dev: vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode development && (vite build --watch --mode development & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & wait)
